opportunities.title: Research Project Grants

amount.raw: The maximum grant value is £500,000. Research Project Grants may be held for up to five years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education in the UK, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. The PI must take responsibility for directing the grant and be employed by the eligible institution (or be a retired academic with close links).
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects for researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education. Assessed via a two-stage process (outline then detailed application). The outline stage is currently paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; the detailed application stage is open for invited applicants with a deadline of 1 September 2026. At least 75% of resources must fund research staff.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who will coordinate the visit; some specialist arts institutions are permitted to apply. The visiting professor must be eminent and from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research within the UK. Priority given to new or recent collaborations and visits with activities beyond research. A Visiting Professorship must last at least 3 and no more than 12 months.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of Fellow's salary costs up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post and who hold a doctorate (thesis submitted for viva by the closing date). Must hold a UK degree or a UK academic position, and must not have held postdoctoral positions totalling 3 or more years. Tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Provides 3-year fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research, with joint support from the Trust and host university. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027, commencing between 1 September 2027 and 1 May 2028.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres (Centenary Research Centre round)

amount.raw: Up to £10 million available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial College London) are eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027. Up to £10 million over up to 10 years.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary Research Leadership Awards)

amount.raw: Awards up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career-stage academics with at least two years full-time research/teaching post after PhD award, holding or nominated for a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent. Must not have held an equivalent award to establish an independent research group, project grant funding over £100k, or led a team of research staff.
opportunities.summary: Funds talented early career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028. Each institution is limited to one bid.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the duration of the Fellowship, resident in the UK, with an established track record. Priority given to those whose teaching and administrative duties have significantly impacted their research.
opportunities.summary: Funds experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable for between 3 and 24 months, assisting with reasonable replacement costs and research expenses. Approximately 100 Fellowships offered each year. Applications materials will be available on the scheme page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired (up to 0.5 FTE) from an academic post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers or an eligible Independent Research Organisation, with an established record of research. Must live in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year.
opportunities.summary: Funds senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Fellowships are tenable for between 3 and 24 months, commencing between 1 August 2027 and 1 July 2028. Application materials will be available on the scheme page during September 2026.
